title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 21, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.1 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 09:17 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 349 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)

All quiet on the Sunwatch front. 👀🌞🖤

A few small sunspot groups and bright active regions are visible today, while the surrounding corona looks fairly routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
